items: 8 quarts skinned and sliced fresh ripe peaches
Divide the peaches among the bags, making sure to leave some head room.
Mix 1 Tbsp of Fruit Fresh and 1/2 cup of sugar into each bag.
Stir the fruit and sugar mixture in the bag.
Allow to sit for 15 minutes or so until some juice forms.
Seal bags and place them in the freezer.
